51582115.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to C-terminal 6xHis-tagged recombinant human CD73 (27 to 547 residues) expressed in mammalian expression system assessed as dissociation constant by SPR analysis

original_paragraph.SPR Analysis: h/m PD-L1 protein was purchased from Sino Biological Inc.: human PD-L1 (catalog number: 10084-NNAH), murine PD-L1(catalog number: 50010-M08H). h/m CD73 protein was purchased from Novoprotein: human CD73 (catalog number: CW84), murine CD73 (catalog number: CI98). SPR assay was carried out using PlexArray HT. In short, the concentration of h/mPD-L1 was diluted to 0.5 mg/mL with sterile water and was fixed to a bare gold-plated PlexArray nanocapture sensor chip via an amide bond. Then, CC-5 (various concentrations) was injected into the flow cell (30 μL) by a nonpulsatile piston pump.
original_paragraph.Figure 6 caption: Figure 6. Binding affinity of CC-5 to h/mPD-L1 (A, B) and h/mCD73 (C, D), as measured by SPR experiments.
original_paragraph.Figure 6 data: Figure 6A: Human PD-L1, Kd=182 nM, concentrations: 10 μM, 5 μM, 1 μM, 0.05 μM. Figure 6B: Murine PD-L1, Kd=368 nM, concentrations: 10 μM, 5 μM, 1 μM, 0.05 μM. Figure 6C: Human CD73, Kd=101 nM, concentrations: 10 μM, 5 μM, 1 μM, 0.05 μM. Figure 6D: Murine CD73, Kd=565 nM, concentrations: 10 μM, 5 μM, 1 μM, 0.05 μM.
original_paragraph.Table 1: CC-5, PD-L1 moiety: BMS1233, CD73 moiety: [structure], PD-1/PD-L1 IC50: 0.006 μM, CD73 IC50: 0.773 μM.
original_paragraph.Results and Discussion: To further verify whether CC-5 can cross-react with CD73, we determined the binding affinity of CC-5 to hCD73 and mCD73 by SPR analysis. As shown in Figure 6C–D, CC-5 dose dependently bound to hCD73 and mCD73 with Kd values of 101 nM and 565 nM, respectively. Collectively, SPR results indicated that CC-5 could bind to h/mPD-L1 and h/mCD73 with high affinity.
